manuscript.title: A prime and powers of fixed bases

scope.finite_allocation: Both complete reflected systems and prescribed prime orders.
scope.auxiliary_primes: All finite rows, the universal larger-index lower bounds, and exact products.
scope.introductory_arithmetic: Candidate nonrepresentability and finite residue classifications.
scope.balanced_sieve: The set of 626 primes and the upper bound for the density of the surviving residue pairs (Lemma 5.1).
scope.base3_minimality: Exhaustive search over all odd integers coprime to 3 between 10 and 118514161 (Theorem 1.5).
scope.common_sums: The three congruences proving the statement on common sums (Proposition 7.1).
scope.odd_sum_counts: The counts printed in the numerical table for two distinct bases (Table 5); no proof depends on them.
